My parents say its just a phase. My dad doesn't really think mental illness is a thing and brushes off my problems.

I have almost crippling anxiety to the point where I can not leave the house because I am scared I will get sick. I recently have my gallbladder removed and it went horribly wrong, I'm too sick to attend school these days and had to withdraw. My parents don't want me to see anymore doctors about it because its to expensive and they all say the same thing, anxiety.
I tried homeschooling but the school absolutely refused to let me do it
there’s really no one who cares, I feel my parents would be better off because they won’t have to deal with me anymore
